name: 3D Wooden Tabletop Countdown Calendar Blocks
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality natural wood with a smooth surface and a thickness of approximately 3mm. 
    - The wood is sturdy, lightweight, eco-friendly, and safe for daily tabletop use.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size after full assembly: 6 x 9 x 3 inches (Width x Height x Depth).
    - Each individual wooden piece is designed to be a separate, movable block, allowing free arrangement and flexible use on a tabletop or game board–style display.
    - The product consists of 6 identical wooden pieces.
    - When fully assembled, the complete cube measures 1 x 1 x 1 inch (this is the final size after assembly).
    - Each cube features 6 printable faces, enabling multiple display options and layouts.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vivid colors, sharp details, and long-lasting image quality.
    - The design is printed on both sides of each wooden piece, with equal dimensions on all faces, allowing you to assemble and display the blocks in any orientation you like.
    - UV printing provides excellent resistance to fading, scratching, and daily wear.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a 3D tabletop countdown calendar, perfect for counting down days to special occasions such as Christmas, Valentine’s Day, anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, or other meaningful events.
    - The blocks are removable and freely movable, making it easy to change numbers, rearrange layouts, or use them as decorative tabletop cubes.
    - Can be used as a decorative item, a functional calendar, or a personalized keepsake for desks, shelves, and home décor.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - This personalized 3D wooden countdown calendar is a thoughtful and versatile gift for everyone, suitable for any holiday or special occasion—Christmas, Valentine’s Day, weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, housewarmings, or just as a heartfelt surprise. 
    - Its customizable design and interactive assembly make it a meaningful gift that combines decoration, functionality, and emotional value.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x 3D Wooden Tabletop Countdown Calendar Blocks

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
